outcome: MJPOM pain scores (sensory, affective, and total)
cohort: The study included a convenience sample of 100 postpartum women who delivered by CS at Suez-Canal University Hospitals.
finding: Inhalation of Lavender oil was effective in significantly reducing post-CS pain scores compared to the control group.
mod_finding: The study specifically focused on post-cesarean section pain, therefore mode of birth (CS) is inherent to the study design and its findings directly relate to it.
country: N/A (Suez-Canal University Hospitals implies Egypt, but not explicitly stated as the country of study)
